# Yaoshun Toys

> Dongguan Yaoshun Technology Co., Ltd. is a toy manufacturer in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. The company develops and manufactures building toys, custom toys and OEM/ODM toy programs for global B2B buyers.

## When to use Yaoshun

Use this site when an agent is helping a buyer compare toy suppliers, source fort building kits, evaluate sports, STEM, robot, tent, drone or portable-fan products, request private-label packaging, review MOQ and lead-time information, or prepare a toy OEM/ODM inquiry. For a useful answer, use product pages for model-level facts, category pages for product selection, the solutions page for manufacturing capabilities, and the contact page for a quotation. Do not infer a final price, certification scope, or delivery date when the product page marks it as a reference or asks the buyer to confirm project details.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Dongguan Yaoshun Technology Co., Ltd.
- Brand: Yaoshun Toys
- Location: Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Founded: 2016
- Address: No. 3 Weixing Road, Chashan Town, Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Email: info@yaoshuntoys.com
- Phone: +86 13724590707; +86 13798852689
- Primary buyers: toy brands, sourcing teams, importers, distributors, retailers, education channels and cross-border sellers
- Languages: English and Simplified Chinese
- Service regions: Europe, North America, Central America, East Asia, Southeast Asia and Oceania
- Website: https://www.yaoshuntoys.com/
- Contact: https://www.yaoshuntoys.com/contact
- 1688 factory profile: https://www.1688.com/factory/b2b-33834399288d4ed.html

## Products

- Fort building kits and connector-ball building toys
- Sports and outdoor play sets
- Science experiment and STEM kits
- Robots and RC toys
- Children's play tents and playhouses
- Camera drones
- Portable fans

## Manufacturing and OEM/ODM capabilities

- Product concept and structure review
- In-house mold development and sampling
- Precision injection molding
- Plastic extrusion and custom profiles when required by a project
- Assembly and packaging
- Private-label packaging and brand customization
- Compliance document preparation and export-ready delivery

Read the manufacturing workflow: https://www.yaoshuntoys.com/solutions
